title: От Матфея 6 — Matthew 6
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Тогда твой ___, который видит и то, что делается в тайне, вознаградит тебя.
cases.translation: Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
cases.explain: Отец is the subject of вознаградит (will reward) → nominative.

cases.sentence: Не копите себе ___ на земле, где их портят моль и ржавчина.
cases.translation: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy.
cases.explain: Genitive of negation: не копите (чего) → богатств, because the verb is negated.

cases.sentence: Прости нам наши долги, как и мы простили ___ нашим.
cases.translation: Forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
cases.explain: простить кому — 'to forgive someone' takes the dative: должникам.

cases.sentence: Вы не можете одновременно служить и ___, и богатству.
cases.translation: You cannot serve both God and money.
cases.explain: служить кому — 'to serve someone' takes the dative: Богу.

cases.translation: Look at the birds of the sky.
cases.explain: на + accusative (direction of looking, animate plural = genitive form): на птиц.

cases.translation: Give us today our daily bread.
cases.explain: дать (что) — the transitive verb governs the accusative: хлеб (identical here to the nominative since хлеб is inanimate).

cases.translation: Let your giving be done in secret.
cases.explain: быть кем/чем — predicate instrumental after быть: тайной (a secret).

cases.sentence: Как делают лицемеры в синагогах и на ___.
cases.translation: As the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the street corners.
cases.explain: на + prepositional (plural) for location: на улицах (in the streets).

reading.ru: Смотрите, не выставляйте свою праведность на показ, иначе вы не получите от Небесного Отца никакой награды.
reading.question: What does Jesus warn against doing with one's righteousness?
options: Showing it off in public for reward
Keeping it completely secret from God
Writing it down in a book
reading.correct: Showing it off in public for reward
reading.explain: Jesus warns against practicing righteousness publicly to be seen by others.

reading.ru: Ты же, когда помогаешь бедным, делай это так, чтобы твоя левая рука не знала, что делает правая.
reading.question: How does Jesus say a person should give to the poor?
options: So secretly that even one's own hands don't 'know' about it
Only in front of the synagogue crowd
reading.correct: So secretly that even one's own hands don't 'know' about it
reading.explain: Jesus says giving should be so secret that the left hand doesn't know what the right is doing.

reading.ru: Ты же, когда молишься, войди в комнату, закрой за собой дверь и помолись своему небесному Отцу, который невидимо находится с тобой».
reading.question: Where does Jesus say a person should pray?
options: In a private room, with the door shut
reading.correct: In a private room, with the door shut
reading.explain: Jesus tells his listeners to pray privately in a room with the door shut.

reading.ru: Дай нам сегодня наш насущный хлеб.
reading.question: In the Lord's Prayer, what does the request 'give us today' ask for?
reading.explain: The Lord's Prayer asks God to give daily bread.

reading.ru: Ты же, когда постишься, умойся и помажь голову твою, чтобы люди не замечали, что ты постишься.
reading.question: What does Jesus instruct about fasting outwardly?
options: Wash your face and anoint your head so no one notices you are fasting
reading.correct: Wash your face and anoint your head so no one notices you are fasting
reading.explain: Jesus instructs that when fasting, one should wash and anoint the head so no one notices.

reading.ru: Копите лучше себе сокровища на небесах, где их не испортят ни моль, ни ржавчина, и куда воры не смогут проникнуть и украсть.
reading.question: Where does Jesus say to store up treasure instead of on earth?
reading.explain: Jesus tells his followers to store up treasures in heaven instead of on earth.

reading.ru: Вы не можете одновременно служить и Богу, и богатству.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about serving two masters?
options: You cannot serve both God and money
You must choose a king to serve
You should serve only the poor
You should serve neither God nor money
reading.correct: You cannot serve both God and money
reading.explain: Jesus says no one can serve both God and money.

reading.ru: Посмотрите на птиц небесных. Они не сеют, не женут, не собирают в хранилище, однако ваш небесный Отец питает их.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about the birds, to teach against anxiety?
options: They don't sow or store food, yet God feeds them
They store huge amounts of grain
reading.correct: They don't sow or store food, yet God feeds them
reading.explain: Jesus points out that the birds neither sow nor store food, yet God feeds them.

reading.ru: Поэтому не тревожьтесь о завтрашнем дне. Завтрашний день сам побеспокоится о себе.
reading.question: How does the chapter conclude regarding worry about the future?
options: Do not worry about tomorrow; tomorrow will worry about itself
Save enough money for ten years
Ask the priests to worry for you
reading.correct: Do not worry about tomorrow; tomorrow will worry about itself
reading.explain: The chapter ends by telling listeners not to worry about tomorrow.
